description: Holds branch review scheme influencer details records, linked to branch review header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report branch review scheme influencer details records, including amounts and quantities, for the Sales Planning & Performance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one branch review scheme influencer detail.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the branch review scheme influencer detail.
columns.business_meaning: Branch Review Scheme Influencer Details identifier

columns.name: header_id
columns.description: Reference to the branch review header linked to this branch review scheme influencer detail.

columns.name: section_type
columns.description: Section type of the branch review scheme influencer detail.

columns.name: client_id
columns.description: Client id of the branch review scheme influencer detail.

columns.name: is_fl
columns.description: True when the branch review scheme influencer detail is fl.

columns.name: is_scheme
columns.description: True when the branch review scheme influencer detail is scheme.

columns.name: total_visits
columns.description: Total visits of the branch review scheme influencer detail.

columns.name: total_sales_qty
columns.description: Total sales qty of the branch review scheme influencer detail.

columns.name: pending_payout_count
columns.description: Pending payout count of the branch review scheme influencer detail.

relationships.description: Each branch review scheme influencer detail references one branch review header (header).

business_rules: Use total_visits / total_sales_qty for monetary or quantity totals.
Columns section_type classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Join to Branch Review Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.

common_metrics.name: Average Total Visits per branch review scheme influencer detail

common_queries: Branch Review Scheme Influencer Details by branch review header
Branch Review Scheme Influencer Details count by section type
Top branch review header by total visits

known_issues: pending_payout_count is nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name BranchReviewSchemeInfluencerDetails (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting branch review scheme influencer detail records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(total_visits) for totals of total visits.
To resolve names, join on: header_id = BranchReviewHeader.Id.
